name: code-review
description: Use this skill when reviewing code — a PR, a diff, or an individual file — or when receiving review feedback. Applies your conventions (accessibility, code-style, error-handling, frontend-security, web-performance) as a checklist, and covers how to give and receive feedback.
do-not-use-when: Writing new code (apply the relevant stack skills instead)
A general question about code quality with no specific diff to review
